commands.title: Open Kit
commands.description: Opens Kit, optionally on a specific tab and rail section.

commands.title: Open phone tools
commands.description: Opens Kit directly on phone pairing, sharing, calls, and screen tools.

commands.title: Open command reference
commands.description: Opens Kit directly on the searchable command reference.

commands.title: Open a preferred app
commands.description: Opens the app chosen for that role in Ryoku Hub, or the shipped default.

commands.title: Run a terminal program
commands.description: Opens the chosen terminal and runs the program inside it.

commands.title: Pair a Bluetooth device
commands.description: Pairs, trusts, and connects the Bluetooth address. A stale bond may be replaced if connection fails.

commands.title: Adjust screen brightness
commands.description: Raises or lowers the internal panel and supported external displays by a percentage.

commands.title: Check keep-awake mode
commands.description: Reports success when Ryoku is currently preventing idle sleep.

commands.title: Keep the computer awake
commands.description: Keeps the desktop awake and remembers the choice across shell restarts.

commands.title: Allow automatic sleep
commands.description: Clears the saved keep-awake request and releases its idle block.

commands.title: Restore keep-awake mode
commands.description: Recreates the idle block only when keep-awake mode was previously saved.

commands.title: Hold sleep temporarily
commands.description: Blocks idle sleep without changing the saved keep-awake preference.

commands.title: Release temporary wake hold
commands.description: Drops a temporary hold while preserving any saved keep-awake request.

commands.title: Toggle keep-awake mode
commands.description: Switches persistent keep-awake mode on or off.

commands.title: Calculate an expression
commands.description: Evaluates arithmetic, functions, percentages, units, or currencies when the full calculator is installed.

commands.title: Pick a screen colour
commands.description: Lets you click a screen colour and copies its value. Repeat mode continues until cancelled.

commands.title: Tint folder icons
commands.description: Builds a small folder-icon theme from the given colour or the current wallpaper palette.

commands.title: Check game mode
commands.description: Reports success when Ryoku game mode is active.

commands.title: Start game mode
commands.description: Applies the desktop and system latency settings used while playing games.

commands.title: Turn game mode on
commands.description: Alias for starting Ryoku game mode.

commands.title: Stop game mode
commands.description: Restores the desktop and system values saved before game mode started.

commands.title: Turn game mode off
commands.description: Alias for stopping Ryoku game mode.

commands.title: Toggle game mode
commands.description: Starts game mode when off, or restores the prior state when on.

commands.title: Search an image
commands.description: Captures a region or uses an image file, uploads it for visual search, and opens the result.

commands.title: Check night light
commands.description: Prints whether night light is on and its saved colour temperature.

commands.title: Warm the display
commands.description: Turns night light on at the saved or requested colour temperature.

commands.title: Turn night light off
commands.description: Returns the display to its normal colour temperature.

commands.title: Toggle night light
commands.description: Switches the display between normal and the saved warm colour temperature.

commands.title: Restore night light
commands.description: Reapplies night light after login only when it was previously enabled.

commands.title: Toggle a warm temperature
commands.description: Turns night light on at the requested temperature, or off when it is already active.

commands.title: Copy text from an image
commands.description: Reads text from a captured region or image file and copies it to the clipboard.

commands.title: Scan a QR code
commands.description: Reads a QR code from a captured region or image, copies the result, and opens web links.

commands.title: List radio stations
commands.description: Prints the built-in radio station catalogue as JSON rows.

commands.title: Check internet radio
commands.description: Prints the current station and playback state as JSON.

commands.title: Play internet radio
commands.description: Starts the requested station, replacing any station already playing.

commands.title: Stop internet radio
commands.description: Stops the station. Aside mode remembers it for a later resume.

commands.title: Resume internet radio
commands.description: Restarts the station most recently stopped with aside mode.

commands.title: Toggle internet radio
commands.description: Stops the current station or starts the requested one.

commands.title: Toggle screen recording
commands.description: Starts a full-screen recording when idle, or finalizes the current recording.

commands.title: Start a screen recording
commands.description: Records the full display, a region, or one monitor with optional audio. Discord mode also creates a smaller copy.

commands.title: Finish a screen recording
commands.description: Stops the recorder cleanly and prints the saved video path.

commands.title: Pause screen recording
commands.description: Pauses the current recording without finalizing its file.

commands.title: Resume screen recording
commands.description: Continues a paused recording.

commands.title: Check recording state
commands.description: Prints whether the screen recorder is recording or idle.

commands.title: Inspect recorder support
commands.description: Prints the selected capture backend, encoder, quality, and frame settings as JSON.

commands.title: Recognize playing music
commands.description: Listens to current audio, identifies the song, and copies the result.

commands.title: Show equalizer state
commands.description: Prints the saved bands, preset, output target, and running state as JSON.

commands.title: Adjust an equalizer band
commands.description: Sets one band in whole decibels and enables the custom equalizer curve.

commands.title: Choose an equalizer preset
commands.description: Applies the named ten-band curve. Flat bypasses the equalizer.

commands.title: Turn the equalizer on
commands.description: Enables the saved equalizer curve on the current default output.

commands.title: Turn the equalizer off
commands.description: Removes the equalizer filter while preserving its saved curve.

commands.title: Reapply the equalizer
commands.description: Rebuilds the audio filter from the saved equalizer state.

commands.title: Move EQ to current output
commands.description: Moves an active equalizer to the current default audio output.

commands.title: Read desktop system info
commands.description: Prints the compact machine dossier consumed by Ryoku's system card.

commands.title: Check image editing support
commands.description: Reports whether the Stage image engine and its models are ready.

commands.title: List image models
commands.description: Lists the supported cutout and inpainting models and their install state.

commands.title: Cut out an image subject
commands.description: Removes an image background with the selected local model and writes a PNG.

commands.title: Fill a masked image area
commands.description: Uses the local image engine to reconstruct the masked area into a new PNG.

commands.title: Install image models
commands.description: Downloads and prepares the selected Stage models, or the default model set.

commands.title: Remove an image model
commands.description: Deletes the selected local Stage model. It must be downloaded again before reuse.

commands.title: Find nearby LocalSend devices
commands.description: Searches the local network and prints compatible receiving devices as JSON.

commands.title: Send a file nearby
commands.description: Transfers one file directly to a LocalSend device on the local network.

commands.title: Send a folder nearby
commands.description: Transfers every supported file in a directory to a LocalSend device.

commands.title: Receive nearby files
commands.description: Advertises this computer on the local network and receives LocalSend transfers.

commands.title: Check the Cobalt helper
commands.description: Prints Docker access and the local Cobalt download service state.

commands.title: Start the Cobalt helper
commands.description: Provisions or starts Ryoku's local Cobalt download container. It may request administrator access.

commands.title: Stop the Cobalt helper
commands.description: Stops Ryoku's local Cobalt container without removing its image or data.

commands.title: Download media to Stash
commands.description: Downloads media through the configured Cobalt service or local fallback into the Stash folder.

commands.title: Repair a stashed video
commands.description: Repackages a downloaded video into a playback-friendly MP4 without replacing the source first.

commands.title: List supported media sites
commands.description: Prints the sites supported by the configured Stash download engine.

commands.title: Compress stashed media
commands.description: Writes smaller copies beside one file or every supported file in Stash. Original files remain unchanged.

commands.title: Download a link to Stash
commands.description: Downloads media from a URL into the Stash folder with the local downloader.

commands.title: Install files from Stash
commands.description: Installs one supported app or package, or everything supported in Stash. Successful sources are removed unless preservation is requested in the environment.

commands.title: Import a key-sound pack
commands.description: Validates and converts a key-sound pack into a Ryoku typing profile.

commands.title: Scale displays automatically
commands.description: Chooses display scales from physical density, applies them, and saves the layout.

commands.title: Save the live display layout
commands.description: Writes the current live display arrangement without changing its scale.

commands.title: Repair display mode drift
commands.description: Reasserts intended display modes after a bad link negotiation. Check mode reports drift without changing it.

commands.title: Mirror all displays
commands.description: Mirrors every other display from the named or currently focused source.

commands.title: Extend across displays
commands.description: Stops mirroring and lays connected displays side by side with density-aware scaling.

commands.title: Toggle mirror or extend
commands.description: Switches connected displays between mirrored and extended layouts.

commands.title: List connected displays
commands.description: Prints connected display details as JSON.

commands.title: Apply a display layout
commands.description: Applies an explicit display layout after snapping each scale to a supported value.

commands.title: Save a display profile
commands.description: Applies a layout and saves it against the connected display hardware.

commands.title: Load a display profile
commands.description: Applies a saved display profile by matching the connected hardware.

commands.title: List display profiles
commands.description: Prints saved display profiles as JSON and marks those matching current hardware.

commands.title: Delete a display profile
commands.description: Deletes the named saved display profile. Its layout cannot be restored from Ryoku afterward.

commands.title: Show the workspace page
commands.description: Prints the current numbered workspace page for the fixed grid model.

commands.title: Focus a workspace slot
commands.description: Focuses a numbered slot on the current workspace page.

commands.title: Move a window to a slot
commands.description: Moves the focused window to a workspace slot and follows it.

commands.title: Send a window to a slot
commands.description: Moves the focused window to a workspace slot without following it.

commands.title: Hide the focused window
commands.description: Moves the focused window into or out of Ryoku's scratch workspace.

commands.title: Toggle hidden windows
commands.description: Shows or hides the scratch workspace while preserving normal workspace focus.

commands.title: List Bluetooth audio cards
commands.description: Prints each connected Bluetooth address and its audio card name.

commands.title: List Bluetooth codecs
commands.description: Lists active and available codecs for one device or every connected Bluetooth audio device.

commands.title: Choose a Bluetooth codec
commands.description: Switches the device to an offered codec and remembers it for reconnection.

commands.title: Forget a codec choice
commands.description: Deletes the saved codec preference for the Bluetooth device.

commands.title: Apply saved Bluetooth codecs
commands.description: Reapplies saved codec choices to connected Bluetooth audio devices.

commands.title: Watch Bluetooth audio
commands.description: Keeps running and reapplies saved codecs when Bluetooth audio cards reconnect.

commands.title: Cap microphone gain
commands.description: Lowers an overdriven default microphone to its zero-decibel base volume to prevent clipping.

commands.title: Check microphone gain
commands.description: Reports the default microphone's current and base volume.

commands.title: Raise the volume
commands.description: Raises the default output volume with Ryoku's stepped volume curve.

commands.title: Lower the volume
commands.description: Lowers the default output volume with Ryoku's stepped volume curve.

commands.title: Find the panel backlight
commands.description: Prints the backlight device that actually drives the connected internal panel.

commands.title: Repair a stuck laptop backlight
commands.description: Applies a hardware-gated boot setting for affected dual-GPU ASUS panels. A wrong boot setting can leave brightness controls unusable until removed.

commands.title: Detect graphics devices
commands.description: Lists graphics devices in strength order and identifies integrated, discrete, and external devices.

commands.title: Show graphics device order
commands.description: Prints the preferred render-device order, optionally including the effective saved value.

commands.title: Save graphics device order
commands.description: Writes the strongest-GPU render order into the selected configuration path.

commands.title: Install stable GPU links
commands.description: Installs device rules that keep graphics device names stable across boots.

commands.title: Show graphics configuration
commands.description: Reports detected graphics hardware, selected mode, and effective render order.

commands.title: Disable graphics pinning
commands.description: Removes the saved strongest-GPU render order so the system chooses devices again.

commands.title: Clear graphics pinning
commands.description: Alias for removing the saved render-device order.

commands.title: Audit graphics pinning
commands.description: Checks whether the saved render order still matches current graphics hardware.

commands.title: Choose a graphics mode
commands.description: Changes which graphics device owns rendering or is reserved for a virtual machine. The wrong mode can blank accelerated apps until changed back.

commands.title: Show hardware graphics mode
commands.description: Reports hardware switch support, current mode, and whether a reboot is pending.

commands.title: Read the hardware GPU switch
commands.description: Prints the current hybrid or discrete hardware graphics mode.

commands.title: Set the hardware GPU switch
commands.description: Changes which GPU drives the internal panel. The change requires a reboot and may increase battery use.

commands.title: Check hardware GPU switching
commands.description: Returns success when this machine exposes a supported hardware GPU switch.

commands.title: Show power settings
commands.description: Reports battery charge limits, PCIe power policy, and hardware support.

commands.title: Read the charge limit
commands.description: Prints the saved battery end threshold or unset.

commands.title: Set a battery charge limit
commands.description: Caps battery charging at the chosen percentage when the hardware supports it.

commands.title: Clear the charge limit
commands.description: Restores a full charge target and deletes the saved limit.

commands.title: Read PCIe power policy
commands.description: Prints the selected PCIe link power-saving policy.

commands.title: Set PCIe power policy
commands.description: Changes PCIe link power saving. Aggressive saving can expose device firmware problems.

commands.title: Inspect power capabilities
commands.description: Prints the CPU, platform, battery, and PCIe controls this machine exposes.

commands.title: Read power profiles
commands.description: Prints one saved CPU power profile or all of them.

commands.title: Define a power profile value
commands.description: Stores one CPU or firmware value in a named power profile.

commands.title: Clear a power profile value
commands.description: Deletes one saved value or the entire profile so firmware defaults take over.

commands.title: Apply a power profile
commands.description: Writes the saved profile values to the current CPU and platform controls.

commands.title: Read idle policy
commands.description: Prints the complete idle policy or one saved setting.

commands.title: Change idle policy
commands.description: Saves an idle enable switch or battery and AC timeout, then refreshes idle handling.

commands.title: Apply saved power settings
commands.description: Converges supported hardware to the power values saved in Ryoku's configuration.

commands.title: Use network-provided DNS
commands.description: Returns DNS resolution to the servers supplied by the current network.

commands.title: Use Cloudflare DNS
commands.description: Sets the system resolver to Cloudflare's public DNS servers.

commands.title: Use Google DNS
commands.description: Sets the system resolver to Google's public DNS servers.

commands.title: Use custom DNS servers
commands.description: Sets the system resolver to the supplied addresses. Invalid servers can stop name resolution until changed back.

commands.title: Block all network traffic
commands.description: Enables Ryoku's network kill switch and disconnects current networking until it is turned off.

commands.title: Restore network traffic
commands.description: Disables the kill switch and restores normal network management.

commands.title: Check the network kill switch
commands.description: Prints whether Ryoku's traffic block is on or off.

commands.title: Restore the saved network block
commands.description: Reapplies the saved kill-switch state during startup.

commands.title: Show the Wi-Fi backend
commands.description: Prints which Wi-Fi service NetworkManager currently uses.

commands.title: Use the iwd Wi-Fi backend
commands.description: Switches NetworkManager to iwd and restarts networking. The connection drops briefly.

commands.title: Use the WPA Wi-Fi backend
commands.description: Switches NetworkManager to its WPA supplicant backend and restarts networking. The connection drops briefly.

commands.title: Disable Wi-Fi power saving
commands.description: Keeps Wi-Fi radios awake to reduce latency and saves their previous state. Battery use increases.

commands.title: Restore Wi-Fi power saving
commands.description: Restores each Wi-Fi radio's saved power-saving state.

commands.title: Check Wi-Fi power saving
commands.description: Prints the current power-saving state for each Wi-Fi device.

commands.title: Read the Wi-Fi country
commands.description: Prints the configured two-letter Wi-Fi country and where it came from.

commands.title: Set the Wi-Fi country
commands.description: Persists the regulatory country and refreshes Wi-Fi. A wrong country can hide legal channels or enable illegal ones.

commands.title: Apply the saved Wi-Fi country
commands.description: Reasserts the saved regulatory country and the preferred 5 GHz ranking.

commands.title: Audit Wi-Fi channels
commands.description: Reports the active country and counts usable and blocked 5 GHz channels.

commands.title: Check Docker access
commands.description: Reports whether Docker is installed, running, and reachable.

commands.title: Prepare Docker for Ryoku
commands.description: Enables Docker and prepares access for Ryoku's local service containers.

commands.title: Check the Cobalt container
commands.description: Reports whether Ryoku's local Cobalt container is absent, stopped, or running.

commands.title: Start the Cobalt container
commands.description: Creates or starts Ryoku's fixed local Cobalt container on the requested loopback port.

commands.title: Stop the Cobalt container
commands.description: Stops Ryoku's local Cobalt container without deleting it.

commands.title: Show the Ryoku system card
commands.description: Runs Fastfetch with Ryoku's current layout, renderer, and wallpaper-derived palette.

commands.title: List Ryoku languages
commands.description: Prints the language codes in Ryoku's shared language table.

commands.title: Extract English UI text
commands.description: Scans the checkout and rewrites the English translation catalogue from source strings.

commands.title: Update translations
commands.description: Translates missing catalogue strings, or every string with force. Automated translation can overwrite weak machine output, though human overrides remain protected.

commands.title: Check translation length
commands.description: Reports translations likely to overflow their controls and optionally fails when any are found.

commands.title: Generate a language locally
commands.description: Uses the configured model to generate complete user-layer translation files. API use may incur charges.

commands.title: Create translation settings
commands.description: Creates the user translation-model configuration template when it is absent.

commands.title: Estimate translation cost
commands.description: Estimates input tokens, output tokens, and price for the next model translation pass without sending it.

commands.title: Check app colour sharing
commands.description: Checks the palette file, background service, local endpoint, and published colours.

commands.title: Stop colouring Spotify
commands.description: Removes Ryoku-owned Spotify colour integration files and settings.

commands.title: Stop colouring Vesktop
commands.description: Removes Ryoku-owned Vesktop theme files, updates its theme list, and reapplies desktop colours.

commands.title: Stop colouring Zen
commands.description: Removes Ryoku-owned Zen browser colour files and reapplies desktop colours.

commands.title: Lock the session
commands.description: Starts the current Qylock generation under Ryoku's guarded lock lifecycle.

commands.title: Find the Windows boot entry
commands.description: Prints the partition identifier and device for a detected Windows boot manager.

commands.title: Print a Windows boot block
commands.description: Prints a Limine chainload block for the given partition identifier without changing files.

commands.title: Sync external boot entries
commands.description: Adds or updates managed Windows and neighboring-system entries. Editing the wrong boot configuration can prevent those entries from starting.

commands.title: Detect the base system
commands.description: Prints the base distribution family used by other Ryoku helpers.

commands.title: Compress a recording
commands.description: Re-encodes a recording into a size budget and leaves the original untouched.

commands.title: Supervise radio playback
commands.description: Maintains one radio stream for the current private playback token.

commands.title: Announce a saved recording
commands.description: Shows the post-save notification and its open, folder, and copy actions for a finished capture.

commands.title: Read extended profile stats
commands.description: Prints the ordered machine statistics consumed by Ryoku Hub's profile dossier.

commands.title: Begin the reload cover
commands.description: Creates a reload or boot cover token and starts the matching protective surface.

commands.title: Finish the reload cover
commands.description: Releases the matching cover after a successful desktop reload.

commands.title: Fail the reload cover
commands.description: Releases the matching cover through its failure path.

commands.title: Show the first-session welcome
commands.description: Consumes the default-rice marker and opens the welcome surface when this account has not seen it.

commands.title: Show the keys hint
commands.description: Shows the first-session reminder for opening Kit's key reference.

commands.title: Preview a Stage colour scheme
commands.description: Asks the palette engine for one wallpaper-derived Stage preview swatch.

commands.title: Preview all Stage schemes
commands.description: Generates every supported wallpaper colour scheme as Stage-compatible JSON.

commands.title: Apply a Stage wallpaper
commands.description: Translates the Stage editor's wallpaper request into Ryoku's wallpaper service while ignoring unsupported compatibility flags.

commands.title: Summon a single window
commands.description: Moves an existing window to the current workspace, or launches it when absent. Native apps can match their app ID.

commands.title: Restart the audio stack
commands.description: Restarts user audio services and may reset a wedged USB audio device. Active playback is interrupted.

commands.title: Apply Bluetooth defaults
commands.description: Converges the system Bluetooth configuration to Ryoku's battery, reconnect, repair, and profile defaults.

commands.title: Guard graphics driver updates
commands.description: Repairs a missing kernel graphics module path and rebuilds boot images after relevant package changes.

commands.title: Load GPU detection helpers
commands.description: Defines Ryoku's shared graphics detection functions; direct execution intentionally prints nothing.

commands.title: Install 32-bit graphics drivers
commands.description: Installs 32-bit graphics libraries matching detected hardware for Wine and Proton games.

commands.title: Detect ASUS lighting hardware
commands.description: Returns success when the machine exposes a supported ASUS laptop lighting interface.

commands.title: Detect QMK keyboards
commands.description: Returns success when a connected keyboard or the named device exposes the QMK/VIA control interface.

commands.title: Run clamshell policy
commands.description: Owns lid handling and watches power and display changes for docked laptops.

commands.title: Start clamshell policy
commands.description: Alias for running the clamshell policy daemon.

commands.title: Stop clamshell policy
commands.description: Releases lid ownership and stops this user's clamshell daemon.

commands.title: Update clamshell session state
commands.description: Releases or reacquires lid ownership as the login session enters or leaves the foreground.

commands.title: Apply a clamshell event
commands.description: Applies lock, suspend, and dock-preservation policy for a compositor lid event.

commands.title: Apply shared lid state
commands.description: Applies shared lid policy and updates the internal panel without replacing its saved layout.

commands.title: Read clamshell state
commands.description: Prints device, power, display, lid, session, owner, and inhibitor state.

commands.title: Check clamshell hardware
commands.description: Returns success when the shared hardware detector classifies this machine as a laptop.

commands.title: Apply gaming system tuning
commands.description: Saves current kernel values and applies Ryoku's measured low-latency gaming settings.

commands.title: Restore system tuning
commands.description: Restores every kernel value saved before gaming tuning was applied.

commands.title: Check gaming system tuning
commands.description: Returns success while a saved gaming tune is active.

commands.title: Detect a laptop
commands.description: Returns success when chassis, battery, input, or lid evidence identifies a laptop.

commands.title: Detect portable hardware
commands.description: Alias for the laptop detection status check.

commands.title: Detect a desktop
commands.description: Returns success when the machine is not classified as a laptop.

commands.title: Print the device class
commands.description: Prints laptop or desktop from Ryoku's shared hardware detector.

commands.title: Start idle handling
commands.description: Renders the idle policy and starts the available idle daemon when policy allows.

commands.title: Stop idle handling
commands.description: Stops every current-user idle daemon and verifies it is gone.

commands.title: Refresh idle handling
commands.description: Renders current policy and restarts idle handling when it is already running.

commands.title: Render idle configuration
commands.description: Writes the idle daemon configuration from power settings without touching the daemon.

commands.title: Read idle status
commands.description: Prints device class, daemon availability, running state, policy state, and config path.

commands.title: Check idle device class
commands.description: Returns the shared laptop detector's status for idle policy gates.

commands.title: Check battery power
commands.description: Returns success when the machine is currently using battery power.

commands.title: Check wall power
commands.description: Returns success when the machine is currently using external power.

commands.title: Dim idle display
commands.description: Lowers the panel to at most 20% and records its exact pre-idle level once.

commands.title: Restore idle brightness
commands.description: Restores the exact panel level saved by the active idle-dim transaction.

commands.title: Turn idle displays off
commands.description: Starts a new idle-display generation and powers outputs down through the active provider.

commands.title: Wake idle displays
commands.description: Retries output wake for the current idle-display generation unless a newer off request supersedes it.

commands.title: Prepare a power package cutover
commands.description: Prepares lock, shell, and service state before a package-owned power lifecycle cutover.

commands.title: Run a power package cutover
commands.description: Performs the guarded package-side transition for Ryoku power and lock services.

commands.title: Finish a deferred cutover
commands.description: Completes package cutover work deferred until the user session can participate.

commands.title: Run the user power cutover
commands.description: Performs the current user's half of a guarded power-service transition.

commands.title: Wait for the lock client
commands.description: Waits for Qylock lifecycle work to reach a safe transition point.

commands.title: Wait for lock clients
commands.description: Waits until incompatible lock clients have drained before replacing their generation.

commands.title: Start the generation guard
commands.description: Acquires the exclusive guard used while replacing a lockscreen generation.

commands.title: Check the generation guard
commands.description: Returns success when the exclusive lockscreen generation guard is ready.

commands.title: Stop the generation guard
commands.description: Releases the lockscreen generation guard.

commands.title: Start the lock launch guard
commands.description: Closes lock-client admission while a compatible staged generation takes over.

commands.title: Check the lock launch guard
commands.description: Returns success when lock-client launch admission is safely guarded.

commands.title: Stop the lock launch guard
commands.description: Reopens lock-client launch admission after cutover.

commands.title: Stop all Qylock guards
commands.description: Releases both lockscreen generation and launch guards after recovery or completion.

commands.title: Quiesce the shell
commands.description: Asks the shell to stop admitting lock work before a guarded transition.

commands.title: Start session lifecycle guards
commands.description: Starts the per-session power and lock lifecycle state used after login.

commands.title: Bind lifecycle to the session
commands.description: Binds power lifecycle ownership to the current login session.

commands.title: Check lifecycle session state
commands.description: Checks that lifecycle ownership still matches the active login session.

commands.title: Watch lifecycle session state
commands.description: Keeps power and lock ownership synchronized as login session activity changes.

commands.title: Check whether a command exists
commands.description: Returns success when the named executable is available on PATH.

commands.title: Install official packages
commands.description: Installs translated official-repository packages through the host package manager.

commands.title: Install community packages
commands.description: Builds community packages one at a time as the current user. Package build scripts can execute arbitrary code.

commands.title: Enable the CachyOS kernel source
commands.description: Adds the v3 kernel repository and signing key without replacing the Arch userland.

commands.title: Enable 32-bit packages
commands.description: Enables the multilib package repository and refreshes package databases.

commands.title: Remove packages
commands.description: Removes translated packages and may also remove dependencies no longer needed.

commands.title: Read Ryostore install state
commands.description: Reports installed and missing items, optionally for one bundle.

commands.title: Install a Ryostore bundle
commands.description: Installs every required item in a catalogue bundle or only the selected names.

commands.title: Install one Ryostore item
commands.description: Installs one named item from a catalogue bundle.

commands.title: Remove a Ryostore bundle
commands.description: Removes every managed item in the bundle. User data owned by those packages may become unavailable.

commands.title: Remove one Ryostore item
commands.description: Removes one managed item from a bundle.

commands.title: Place a desktop plugin
commands.description: Writes a plugin's desktop position and optional visual settings.

commands.title: Place a frame popout
commands.description: Writes a plugin's frame edge, alignment, and activation geometry.

commands.title: Place a sidebar card
commands.description: Writes a plugin card's sidebar tab, order, label, and glyph.

commands.title: Set a plugin host
commands.description: Changes the surface that hosts an installed plugin.

commands.title: Set plugin availability
commands.description: Enables or disables a plugin and seeds its defaults when first enabled.

commands.title: Merge plugin settings
commands.description: Merges the supplied JSON object into an installed plugin's settings.

commands.title: Seed plugin defaults
commands.description: Creates the plugin's placement and settings entry from its manifest defaults.

commands.title: Restore plugin placement
commands.description: Restores the exact prior plugin entry and removes a newly created empty store when needed.

commands.title: Forget plugin placement
commands.description: Deletes the plugin's placement and settings entry.

commands.title: Activate the staged lockscreen
commands.description: Atomically replaces the live Qylock generation under lifecycle guards.

commands.title: Prepare lockscreen replacement
commands.description: Closes lock admission and drains incompatible clients before activation.

commands.title: Prepare a guarded unlock
commands.description: Creates a durable sleep guard and verifies the session is safe to unlock.

commands.title: Apply the Ryoku boot look
commands.description: Synchronizes boot branding, splash settings, and boot images after a package update.

commands.title: Reload authorization rules

commands.title: Rename a virtual machine

commands.title: Grow a virtual disk

commands.title: List VM snapshots

commands.title: Snapshot a virtual machine

commands.description: Replaces the stopped machine's current disk state with the snapshot. Newer guest changes are lost.

commands.description: Removes a GPU-passthrough machine and can destroy its guest storage.

commands.description: Reports the configuration and lifecycle state of a GPU-passthrough machine.
